children.title: Cycle 56 · Investigating Preference Emergence and Architectural Boundaries

detail.title: Investigating Preference Emergence and Architectural Boundaries
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the previous failed experimental measurement regarding preference formation, interpreting the instrument failure as a limitation of current observability rather than a refutation of the hypothesis. The research continues by formalizing an investigation decision to refine the experimental protocol for isolating memory ingestion within architectural trust boundaries.
